title: Reminder
body: I really like this app, but one thing: I cant delete reminders. When I tap “Delete this reminder” the app closes itself and when I open it again, the reminder is still there.
author: euroteck

title: Addictive
body:
Loving the app! I could finally replace the spreadsheet for tracking my daily/weekly habits. Will totally pay for the pro version if I can stick to it.
Only suggestion though is to improve the visuals on iPad, looks a bit strange there.
Otherwise great job guys!
Cheers 
Peter
author: MrChipet

title: The best habit tracker app for free
body: In the most habit tracker app you can only follow three habits, here the minimum is five, the monthly page is really nice, easy to use :)
author: Fancsita

title: Free, easy to use
body: You can create 5 habits in the free version, track your daily progress, set reminders etc. Best app
